ocr.markdown:
Crab Rangoon (Baked)
8oz imitation crab or 1 can crabmeat or imitationcrd
1/4 - 1/2 c. Mayo
1 pkg cream cheese
1/4 - 1/2 c. sliced gr. onion
1 pkg square wonton wrappers (Pasta wrap - Produce section)
Cream together crab, mayo, cr. cheese + gr. onion.
Carefully put wonton wrappers in muffin tin to form
"cup". Place approx 1 tsp crabmeat mixture in each
"cup". Bake in 350° oven for 15-18 min. or until wrapper
